column1: # poscorr_comparison.py: gains on, Moller rejection off, non-linearity off (arm gp); res_cb, res_g2 (sigma/E, %) and mu_ep (%) are means and standard errors over splits.  sample in = gains and position correction fitted on all splits of the run type, evaluated on every split; sample out = even/odd cross fit (within each run ordinal split numbers 0, 1, 2, ...; fit on one half, evaluate the other half; every split has one out-of-sample value; mean +- standard error over all splits).  res_cb_odd_half_splits / res_cb_even_half_splits (out rows): mean over the odd-ordinal / even-ordinal splits (fit on the even / odd half).  d_cb, d_cb_se: paired per-split res_cb difference to the current choice of the run type at the same sample and path (0 on the current row itself; current = hybrid3000 for 2.24 and 3.49 GeV hydrogen, map12 for 0.73 GeV and X17).  gap_cb, gap_cb_se (out rows): paired per-split in minus out res_cb (negative: out-of-sample worse).  Splits whose fit is NaN (3p49GeV_H2 run 24937: gain solve fails, as in the benchmark report) count in n_splits but not in means.  Diagnostics: own_modules = seed modules with an own polynomial, own_fits_failed = modules above the count threshold whose fit failed, map_bins_fitted / total, global_fit pass or FAIL (FAIL: R = 1); out rows: even-half|odd-half training.  2p24GeV_Ta_X17: gains are its own; the position correction of every variant is the in-sample fit of the same variant on 2p24GeV_H2 (including its own polynomials), for both samples; the current code borrows only the map, so X17 map12 is the current production.  Total wall time of the driver 370 s.
